授業概要
キャリア形成のうえで必要な自己分析・自己理解を深め、将来必要とされる社会人基礎力を学ぶ。
また、社会人の経験談や、他の学生との意見交換などを通じて主体的に自らのキャリアをデザインできるようになることを目的とする。
Students will deepen their self-analysis and self-understanding—essential for career development—and learn the foundational skills required of professionals in the future.
The course also aims to help students proactively design their own careers through hearing from working professionals and exchanging ideas with fellow students.
